text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to lose any more. No, I 
can't be that complacent...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Put me in the next race right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I lose, I have to win twice as much. I 
have to prove that I'm not weak...!
choice_data_list:
Rest your body for now and prepare for 
what's next.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to rest! Staying a loser 
is something I just can't...!
choice_data_list: You are strong. That will never change.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I really am strong. No 
matter how many times I lose, that won't 
change...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I almost lost sight of myself 
there. Yeah, I really need to rest 
properly right now...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
To make our next victory an overwhelming 
one...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know that much... But I don't want 
things to stay like this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't forgive my weak self, it's so 
frustrating... I can't bear it for even 
one second!
choice_data_list:
Then there's only one thing we need to do 
now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I will. I'm gonna get so strong that no 
one will ever pass me again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Victory, the cheers, our pride— I'll take 
them all back with these legs...!
